choice_and_oracle.causal_choice: highest predicted utility above strongest matched prior-only comparator; otherwise deterministic fallback
choice_and_oracle.causal_support: retained seed-agnostic actions that are pre-event AVAILABLE on the issue plus mandatory comparators
choice_and_oracle.global_oracle: optional ceiling over the complete pre-event-available seed-aggregated catalog; label separately and never use as paired regret denominator
choice_and_oracle.paired_oracle: highest realized seed-aggregated utility over the exact same causal support for that fold/issue

forbidden_choice_inputs: realized outcome/SP/payout/tax/ROI from validation or test

ATLAS167.allocator_score: for each retained selector, exhaust all 963 seed-agnostic allocators and use aggregate sum pre-tax net / sum stake; minimum 20; higher is better
ATLAS167.mandatory_additions: FULL_ENUMERATED M2187 and B167 Q_WEIGHT/WOR_DISTINCT/M64 for every retained selector when supported, plus STATIC_BEST_FULL_FULL
ATLAS167.selector_score: aggregate sum pre-tax net / sum stake over active settled screen issues; minimum 20; higher is better

hierarchical_screen.DIVERGENCE190: retain every AVAILABLE selector crossed with all four deterministic arms; weak arms remain controls and cannot demote STATIC_BEST_FULL_FULL
hierarchical_screen.timing: run on inner-train only during tuning; after model-family selection rerun identically on full outer-train before outer-test refit

model_topology.action_inputs: none inside fitted model; action identity is fixed by deterministic hierarchical screening
model_topology.loss: unweighted mean squared error across active settled training issues for that action
model_topology.target: seed-aggregated issue utility = aggregate pre-tax net / aggregate stake
model_topology.tax: pre-tax target is primary; tax-adjusted values are reporting-only
model_topology.zero_stake: exclude from model fit and keep explicit NO_BET zero-flow in policy path

nested_fit.inner_train: fit transforms, hierarchical screen and one action-specific model for each retained action
nested_fit.inner_validation: simulate one policy path using only pre-event availability and predictions
nested_fit.outer_refit: select one model configuration, rerun screen on full outer-train, refit transforms and action models on full outer-train, then evaluate untouched outer-test
nested_fit.primary_validation_score: sum chosen-action pre_tax_net_yuan / sum chosen-action stake_yuan; blank/invalid when total stake is zero

outcome_boundary: Gate A outcome-unexposed: no target result, final/winning SP, payout, tax realization, ROI, settlement, or post-cutoff evidence enters Tier-C features, transforms, action ranking, or tie-breaks
replay_unit: exact frozen seed row retained in allocation_action_catalog.csv.gz

seed_aggregation.availability: if any required frozen replicate is unavailable or missing, the entire seed-agnostic issue-action is UNAVAILABLE and excluded from fit/ranking; never encode missing seed as losing stake
seed_aggregation.dispersion: publish replicate-level ROI mean, sample SD, MCSE, q05/q50/q95, minimum, maximum and positive fraction separately; never optimize them except as a reported stability diagnostic
seed_aggregation.economics: arithmetic mean replicate stake/gross/tax/net on identical issue/support represents one randomized-strategy action; never sum seed stakes as purchased exposure; deterministic singleton is identity
seed_aggregation.issue_identity: namespace + selector + causal allocator + canonical issue
seed_aggregation.ordering: sort exact numeric seed then replay row identity before accumulation
seed_aggregation.ranking_boundary: aggregate before selector screening, allocator screening, model fitting, policy choice, oracle, regret or promotion
seed_aggregation.required_replicates: exact replay_row_set_sha256 and frozen_seed_set_sha256 from causal_allocation_catalog.csv
seed_aggregation.target: seed-aggregated issue utility = mean replicate pre-tax net / mean replicate stake, equivalently sum net / sum stake; blank when mean stake is zero

streaming.chunk_invariance: output identity and scores must be byte-identical for chunk sizes 1, 17, 256 and 4096
streaming.memory_boundary: may stream issue-action rows; must not shrink any frozen source catalog or seed ensemble
streaming.screen_implementation: complete streaming pass with fixed-size exact top-K heaps; compare full tie tuple; no sampling, adaptive pruning or outcome-dependent early stopping
